Download a Timestral checkpoint

Source: R/safetensors.R
timestral_download.Rd

Downloads config.json and model.safetensors from a Hugging Face Hub repository, cached per user. A size names the official Mistral AI repository (Modified MIT weights licence); any other "owner/name" repository holding a Timestral checkpoint in the same format (for example a fine-tuned model) can be given by its ID.

Usage

timestral_download(
  model = "5M",
  revision = NULL,
  cache_dir = tools::R_user_dir("timestralR", "cache"),
  local_files_only = FALSE,
  token = Sys.getenv("HF_TOKEN", "")
)

Arguments

model

one of "5M", "28M", "123M", "209M", or a Hub repository ID such as "mistralai/Timestral-5M". The official repositories are pinned whichever way they are named.

revision

Hub revision (branch, tag or commit). The default NULL uses the pinned upstream commit for an official size, whose files are verified against recorded SHA-256 hashes, and "main" for any other repository. Branch and tag names are resolved to their current commit on the Hub (the resolution is cached for offline use); files at revisions other than the pinned ones are not hash-verified.

cache_dir

where to keep the files

local_files_only

only read from the cache, never download

token

Hugging Face access token for private or gated repositories; defaults to the HF_TOKEN environment variable

Value

The checkpoint directory.

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
timestral_download("5M")
timestral_download("mistralai/Timestral-5M")   # the same, pinned
} # }
